root_cause: scikit-learn/scipy installed locally but missing from `requirements.lock`
prevention: Clean install from the lock file before push; CI imports every module

what: A failed fetch looked like "no state yet", so a save could overwrite the real paper state
root_cause: `restore` treated any fetch error as an absent branch
correction: `ls-remote --exit-code` separates absent from unreachable; job fails

what: A failed push printed "nothing to save"
Same-day re-runs added equity marks; the dashboard summed operating cost over them
correction: One mark per account per UTC day; migration
verified: Actions run 4: 2 → 1 mark per day, orders and fills unchanged

what: Committed journal rows could sit in the SQLite WAL and be lost on save

root_cause: Save switched the job's checkout to `paper-state`, deleting `scripts/`
correction: Save commits from a separate worktree
prevention: Round-trip test asserts the checkout stays on `main` with its files

what: Workflow YAML would not parse (`Recovered: …` as a plain scalar)
prevention: tests/test_workflows_parse.py parses every workflow in CI

what: Coverage gate aborted with HTTP 400 "invalid symbol"
root_cause: Asset master lists ~431 CUSIP-like and `_DELISTED` entries
correction: Ticker filter; a rejected symbol is dropped, not fatal

what: Asset master not survivorship-free: 12–37% of merger-delisted tickers per year; TWTR/SIVB/BBBY/ATVI absent
root_cause: Alpaca keeps only some delisted assets
correction: Universe adds corporate-action tickers and dedupes FB/META-style mappings; periods moved to 2020+ (ORB Amendment 4)
verified: Residual bias (non-merger delistings) reported in results

what: Commit 874bc38 was pushed with a failing test
verified: Pushes gated on pytest's own exit code

what: P1's final window was read with no qualifying candidate
root_cause: Pre-registration said run it "for the record"
prevention: ORB B9: the final window is read only if a configuration qualifies; enforced in `research/orb/study.py` (test)

what: "Paper trading is live" was claimed when nothing ran continuously
correction: STATUS.md separates configured, verified and running

what: Broker allow-list matched by prefix, so `/v2/account/configurations` would have passed
"Refuse a second final run" was presented as overfitting protection
correction: Freeze by hash; reproduce-only re-runs; consumed-data ledger

what: One request to sec.gov carried the owner's email address in its User-Agent header
root_cause: SEC asks for a contact in the User-Agent; I used the owner's address without asking
correction: Stopped; later requests use a non-personal identifier
prevention: Personal data is never sent to an outside service without the owner's say-so; the SEC contact is the owner's choice

what: The detached ORB development run died partway through with URLError: Connection refused
root_cause: http_get retried 429 and 5xx responses but let transport exceptions escape
correction: Transport errors become a retryable 599 (8 retries, backoff capped at 60 s); the runner restarts itself up to 10 times and resumes from the cache

what: Container restart (~04:10 UTC) killed the detached ORB development run and the 2021 prefetch
root_cause: Cloud session containers restart; background processes do not survive, files on disk do
correction: Idempotent relauncher (`ensure_orb.sh`) called by 20-minute self check-ins; every request result is cached on disk, so a restart loses at most about 20 minutes of progress
verified: Relaunch at 04:30 resumed from the cache

what: GitHub Actions ran the 15-minute crypto schedule only at 03:52 and 04:25 (2 of about 5 slots)
root_cause: GitHub's free scheduler delays and drops cron runs under load
correction: None possible within Actions; the runner catches up on every missed bar, so no data is lost, but decisions run 30+ minutes late
prevention: Watchdog alerts if no success in 2 h. Real intraday trading needs an always-on host, not Actions
